citation.authors: Okokon EO, Verbeek JH et al

cited_by.title: Dry, itchy, flaky scalp and dandruff

record.population: Adolescents and adults with seborrhoeic dermatitis of the face or scalp, randomised trials in mixed populations
record.finding: Topical ketoconazole 2% gave a 31% lower risk of failed clearance than placebo at four weeks (risk ratio 0.69, 95% CI 0.59-0.81, low-quality evidence), a remission rate similar to steroids with fewer side effects, and results similar to ciclopirox. The authors note that 24 trials appeared to have conflicts of interest such as pharmaceutical funding.
record.note: Trials were not selected for afro hair or dark skin.
